title: Satender Kumar Antil v. Central Bureau of Investigation

content.caseIdentity: Satender Kumar Antil v. Central Bureau of Investigation, (2022) 10 SCC 51
content.holding: Laid down comprehensive nationwide category-wise bail guidelines (Categories A to D), stressing that bail must be granted without arrest where appearance notice is complied with.
content.relevance: Standard operating bail procedure and liberty jurisprudence in trial courts.

evidence.note: 2-Judge Bench judgment in SLP (Crl.) No. 5191 of 2021; 2022 INSC 690; (2022) 10 SCC 51.
